summary.intent: Plan and fully execute Phase 67 (TEE Lease-Renewer Contract Rewrite): rewrite the TEE worker from a record originator into a lease-renewer that verifies-in-enclave and re-signs IPNS records without incrementing sequence or repointing CID, per requirements TEE-01 through TEE-06.
summary.outcome: All 8 plans across 3 waves were implemented and committed on feat/tee-lease-renewer-contract-rewrite. The live sdk-e2e round-trip gate passed (equal-seq, equal-CID, later-EOL renewal; tombstoned names never re-signed). Phase marked complete 8/8 with verifier score 8/8. One post-hook commit for tracking artifacts was unresolved at session end.

repo: apps/api/app.module.ts:85 defaults DB to 'cipherbox', but apps/api/.env has DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test — migration CLI reads .env and targets the wrong DB; always override with DB_DATABASE=cipherbox when running migrations locally
mock-ipns-routing occupies 127.0.0.1:3001; local tee-worker simulator must map to host port 3002 (TEE_WORKER_URL=http://localhost:3002)
Simulator TEE key is deterministic: HKDF from fixed seed 'cipherbox-tee-simulator-seed' — rebuilding the tee-worker does not rotate keys, so tee_key_state remains valid across restarts
tee_key_state columns are current_public_key (bytea, hex-encode before use) and current_epoch — not public_key
TypeORM .innerJoin() + .take() pagination throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading databaseName)' metadata error; use paired .find() calls with explicit where/relations instead
The running API on :3000 is always a compiled dist/main (not watch mode); it must be rebuilt and restarted for code changes to take effect in live testing
Pre-existing tsc errors exist in ipns-verify-cache.spec.ts (Phase 66 legacy) and http-metrics.interceptor.spec.ts (HttpArgumentsHost import); tsconfig.build.json excludes specs and is clean

The LessThanOrEqual in republish.service.ts is for the time-based nextRepublishAt schedule query, NOT the sequence write-back — the renewal CAS uses equality (sequence_number = :expected AND tombstoned_at IS NULL)

apps/tee-worker/Dockerfile COPYs pnpm-lock.yaml and pnpm-workspace.yaml from the monorepo root; Docker build context must be the repo root (context: ..) with dockerfile: apps/tee-worker/Dockerfile, not context: ../apps/tee-worker
sdk-e2e test-login uses SDK_E2E_SECRET (default 'e2e-test-secret-do-not-use-in-production'); the API must be started with TEST_LOGIN_SECRET set to the same value for auth to pass
createSubfolder returns ipnsPrivateKey (D-09 terminal-owner convention) — the sdk-e2e suite can destructure it directly to derive ipnsName for polling
Tombstone endpoint is POST /ipns/tombstone with body { ipnsName }

code.finding: ReEnrollRequiredError is thrown BEFORE any decryptIpnsKey/unwrap call — stale key never gets decrypted; defense-in-depth is correctly ordered
decryptIpnsKey zeroes the TEE keypair private key in a finally block — key is wiped on every exit path
renewIpnsRecord takes no cid or sequence arg — value and sequence sourced exclusively from parseIpnsRecord(marshaledExistingRecord), structurally cannot repoint or increment
Mandatory verify-before-decrypt ordering: verifyIpnsRecordSignature at 108-118 with continue on failure; decryptWithFallback at 122 only reached on successful verify
Binding check uses deriveEd25519PublicKey(decryptedKey) vs publicKeyFromIpnsName(ipnsName) — never uses parsed.pubKey (undefined for Ed25519 identity records)
newSequenceNumber: parsed.sequence.toString() — sequence sourced from parsed record, never incremented
ReEnrollRequiredError response: requiresReEnroll: true, error: 'RE_ENROLL_REQUIRED', no key bytes in message
Simulator key derived via HKDF from fixed seed 'cipherbox-tee-simulator-seed' — deterministic across rebuilds, tee_key_state stays valid
DB name defaults to 'cipherbox' here (runtime), while apps/api/.env has DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test (migration CLI) — these diverge and cause migrations to target the wrong DB

getDueEntries was rewritten from innerJoin+take (runtime crash: TypeORM databaseName metadata error) to paired .find() calls with tombstonedAt IS NULL + encryptedIpnsPrivateKey NOT NULL filter — the two-layer tombstone guarantee is preserved

workflow: Grep-based acceptance criteria in plans create a perverse incentive: executors write code that satisfies the grep but may be functionally wrong at runtime (67-07 used query builder innerJoin specifically to pass a QB-presence grep, which introduced the databaseName crash only the live e2e caught)

Plan-checker suggestions can themselves be wrong — it suggested '@Column count = 6' when the real retained count was 7 (missed userId); always verify by reading the actual file rather than accepting the checker's fix verbatim

Unit tests that mock TypeORM query builders cannot catch metadata resolution errors that only surface on real DB connections; the sdk-e2e live round-trip is the only gate that catches this class of bug
gsd commit helper consistently reports commit_failed as a false-negative (1Password SSH signing returns non-zero but the commit lands); always verify with git log --oneline -1, never retry blindly
pnpm monorepo worktrees lack node_modules and built dist; sequential execution on the main tree with per-package scoped test runs is more reliable than parallel worktree agents for this repo
When running a live e2e gate, rebuild sdk-core dist first (pnpm --filter @cipherbox/sdk-core build) — the e2e imports the built dist, not source

The Wave 1 intentional compile break (entity slimmed, callers not yet updated) should be explicitly documented in the orchestration plan so the post-Wave-1 gate can be scoped accordingly rather than attempting a full typecheck

friction: DB name split: apps/api/.env has DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test but app.module.ts defaults to 'cipherbox' — migration CLI ran against the wrong DB (cipherbox_test), requiring a second explicit DB_DATABASE=cipherbox migration run

Stale running instances: both the API on :3000 (2+ weeks old dist/main) and the tee-worker on :3002 (pre-67-06 container) were running stale code and required explicit rebuild+restart before the live gate
test-login 401: API must be started with TEST_LOGIN_SECRET matching the e2e default; not documented in the plan and caused all 5 e2e suites to fail until the restart with the correct env var
67-08 readTeeKeys used wrong SQL column name (public_key vs current_public_key) — TypeScript cannot catch wrong raw SQL column names, only caught at runtime
getDueEntries query-builder + take() caused databaseName crash only surfaced by live e2e; the 67-07 unit spec's mocked QB never exercised this path, giving false confidence
1Password SSH signing causes commit tool timeouts (exit non-zero but commit lands) — required a verify-don't-retry discipline on every commit throughout the session
Bash sandbox permission rules blocked dotenv file reads and some grep patterns involving env files, requiring workarounds
Phase-67 completion tracking commit failed at session end due to husky pre-commit hook (lint-staged failure); root cause not diagnosed before transcript ended
Plan-checker's @Column count suggestion was wrong (suggested 6, correct was 7) — required reading the entity file to get ground truth before editing the plan

cipherbox_test DB on local postgres is a stray (the CI DB name got into .env); should be cleaned up to avoid future migration-to-wrong-DB confusion
Phase 68 (web integration, next in ROADMAP) — client re-enroll consumer that handles requiresReEnroll signal from the TEE was deliberately deferred from Phase 67
Broader ValidityType verify-stack hardening (Rust/TS lockstep) deferred out of Phase 67 scope

sdk-e2e tee-republish suite has pre-existing errors in other suite files (FolderChild, SealedChildRef.id etc.) from v2.0 schema-in-progress work — not introduced by Phase 67 but will block a clean sdk-e2e full run until addressed in a later phase
